_comment: The Hold — region package manifest (ENGINEERING_CONSTRAINTS.md §7). Foundations ships the shape with the one area that exists; the remaining Act One anchors (Last Post, Near Enough, Wren's post, Hobb's village) arrive with their content in phases 3-4. fill_slots and edges are empty because v1 fills every slot by hand.

fill_slots._comment: DEV SCENE, not content. regions/hold/areas/weirdness_test.tscn carries one FlickerSpot per v1 flicker kind so the handlers can be driven headlessly (WEIRDNESS_SPEC §8). The region.json shape has no 'dev' field, so this comment is the marker; the area is a fill slot rather than an anchor because it is not plot-bearing and may never set a critical flag (§7).
